_comment: Lifecycle event case pool -- for p06-trigger-event (migration list item 4, not yet implemented). Fields: eventType = event type; needsApproval = whether it goes through four-eyes approval (true events produce a checker task); partialPct = percentage for partial events, empty for non-partial events; notes = free text.
_format: Contract: see lib/rows.js: a rows array, keys starting with _ are comments, all values are treated as strings.
_rowIdentity: No hand-maintained id column. eventType is the natural key (9 bounded values) and is what a metric tag should carry; the auto-injected __row (1-based) identifies a row positionally in logs and preflight errors -- same convention as create-trade.json.
